mapper.sql: id, university_id, name, name_cn, slug, program_type, field, term_length, teaching_language, duration_months, tuition_amount, tuition_currency, summary, image_media_id, is_featured, is_hot, publish_status, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select id from nad_program where university_id = #{universityId} and name = #{name} limit 1
select id from nad_program where slug = #{slug} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into nad_program (university_id, name, name_cn, slug, program_type, field, term_length, teaching_language, duration_months, tuition_amount, tuition_currency, summary, image_media_id, is_featured, is_hot, publish_status, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{universityId}, #{name}, #{nameCn}, #{slug}, #{programType}, #{field}, #{termLength}, #{teachingLanguage}, #{durationMonths}, #{tuitionAmount}, #{tuitionCurrency}, #{summary}, #{imageMediaId}, #{featured}, #{hot}, #{publishStatus}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update nad_program set university_id = #{universityId}, name = #{name}, name_cn = #{nameCn}, slug = #{slug}, program_type = #{programType}, field = #{field}, term_length = #{termLength}, teaching_language = #{teachingLanguage}, duration_months = #{durationMonths}, tuition_amount = #{tuitionAmount}, tuition_currency = #{tuitionCurrency}, summary = #{summary}, image_media_id = #{imageMediaId}, is_featured = #{featured}, is_hot = #{hot}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
update nad_program set image_media_id = #{mediaId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select m.id, m.program_id, m.department_id, d.name as department_name, m.level, m.name, m.name_cn, m.sort_order from nad_program_major m left join nad_department d on d.id = m.department_id where m.program_id = #{programId} order by m.sort_order asc, m.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_program_major (program_id, department_id, level, name, name_cn, sort_order) values (#{programId}, #{departmentId}, #{level}, #{name}, #{nameCn}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select level from nad_program_level where program_id = #{programId} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_program_level (program_id, level, sort_order) values (#{programId}, #{level}, #{sortOrder})
insert into nad_program_intake (program_id, term, application_open, application_close, sort_order) values (#{programId}, #{term}, #{applicationOpen}, #{applicationClose}, #{sortOrder})
